templates.why_chosen: Vertical five-stage pipeline that pairs every stage with a thumbnail of the artefact it produces; legend on the right.
templates.what_to_learn: An output-artefact column beside the stage column turns abstract stage names into concrete data structures without any extra prose.

templates.why_chosen: The annotation-rail variant: a five-stage vertical pipeline pairs every stage box with a small red-labelled thumbnail of its output artifact, from a MetaGraph icon down to a per-worker execution-plan timeline.
templates.what_to_learn: Give every stage in a vertical pipeline its own small thumbnail icon of the concrete data structure it outputs, aligned in a right-hand rail, so an abstract stage name (Graph Contraction, Wavefront Scheduler) is anchored to a picture rather than left purely verbal.

templates.why_chosen: The inline-glyph variant: a tiny Computation Graph icon of two branching tasks sits at the very start of the pipeline, exactly the 20-30pt DAG-as-icon convention the template calls out, feeding into a five-stage annotated planner.
templates.what_to_learn: When a DAG is only the trigger for a pipeline rather than the figure's subject, shrink it to a small multi-coloured icon (20-30pt) rather than drawing it at full scale, and let the rest of the figure show what consumes it.
